target: WCAG 2.2 AA for product UI, plus the release-specific assistive-technology checks below
evidencePolicy: Automated browser evidence may certify DOM/keyboard/reflow/media-query behavior. VoiceOver, TalkBack, actual browser zoom, and Windows High Contrast must be executed in the named real OS/assistive-technology environment and may not be inferred from emulation.
automated: keyboard-only fresh lesson entry and interactive board operation
keyboard-only independent-play entry and move placement
320 CSS px reflow in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
large-text plus high-contrast reflow at 320 CSS px
interactive board accessible name, role description, keyboard shortcuts, instructions, and live focused-coordinate status
Chromium forced-colors board structure and visible focus
AA text-token contrast on light and dark paper surfaces
3:1 focus-indicator contrast on light and dark paper surfaces

manual.environment: Current iPhone/iPad Safari or installed Home Screen app with VoiceOver
checks: Home controls are announced with meaningful names and roles
Lesson heading/instruction order is understandable
Interactive Go board is announced by label and custom role description
Board instructions are discoverable
Focused/interacted coordinates and stone state are announced without duplicate SVG noise
Feedback/status/error messages are announced
Precision Zoom control state is announced
No focus trap prevents leaving the board or returning home

manual.environment: Current Android Chrome or installed PWA with TalkBack
checks: Home controls are announced with meaningful names and roles
Lesson and Play setup reading order is coherent
Interactive board label/instructions/status are discoverable
Board interaction does not create duplicate SVG announcements
Feedback/status/error messages are announced
Precision Zoom control state is announced
No focus trap prevents leaving the board or app section

manual.environment: Windows current stable Edge/Chrome with Windows High Contrast / forced colors
checks: Text, controls, focus, board grid, black/white stones, last move, and teaching highlights remain distinguishable
No critical meaning depends on preserved author colors
Disabled and selected states remain identifiable

manual.environment: Desktop Chromium and Firefox; Safari where available
checks: 200% browser zoom preserves all core controls and reading order
400% browser zoom preserves reflow without two-dimensional page scrolling outside the Go board/game exception
Focused controls are not obscured
Precision board scrolling remains contained inside its viewport

manual.environment: At least one desktop OS and one mobile OS with Reduce Motion enabled
checks: Decorative transitions and stone/highlight animation are suppressed
No essential state change relies on animation
Scrolling/focus movement remains usable
Larger interface text does not clip labels or controls
Higher contrast remains readable in light and dark system themes
320px-equivalent narrow layout remains usable

recordFields: assistive technology and version if applicable
